DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The finding records the 22:26 writer as UNATTRIBUTED; the evidence in my scratchpad and transcript attributes it to my own mutation matrix.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Attributed it to myself in this record, the commit message of 1325494 and the meta-test's docstring, rather than leaving the finding's UNATTRIBUTED standing.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: An attribution that names the actor who made it is strictly more information; the coordinator can amend the finding.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Left unattributed, the finding's residual says the guard 'attributes on the next run' — it never would have, because the writer was not a suite in the battery but a mutation harness outside it.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The generator's fix for links to other canonical files had no specification: keep the link, drop the link, or fail.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Keep the words, drop the link (alias, else 'fragment (file label)', else the file label), because the vault is documented as self-contained and the fail-closed check exists to catch generator bugs, not to refuse the real registries.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Reversible in one function; the README's documented behaviour is restored; the unresolved-wikilink check is untouched.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: Failing would leave the documented command broken; keeping the link would leave a dangling wikilink in every vault.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: The meta-test's guard could record writes and refuse after the fact (as instructed) or refuse before the bytes land.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.default: Both: the attempt is recorded with its mode AND refused in the child before any byte lands, then the row, the verdict and --enforce carry it.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: Recording alone would let the write happen during measurement — the incident under instrumentation; refusing before is strictly safer and the record survives.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A suite that writes a real artefact would still destroy it once, on the run that detects it.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.condition: GUARDED_TREES: the runner guards eight trees; the corpus roots add files/ and _external_repos/.

DEFAULTS_TAKEN.why_safe: An unversioned PDF under files/ is unique material — deleting it is a §21d reserved act; refusing to touch it is the conservative side.
DEFAULTS_TAKEN.what_would_have_been_different: A suite deleting a PDF under files/ would pass the runner's guard (git cannot see files/) and mine alike.

INCIDENT_20260910_2226_ATTRIBUTED.attribution: SELF. The writer was this task's mutation matrix. Mutation M6 of dossier_quote_audit (scratchpad mut_dqa.json) replaced the dossier read with `path.write_text("touched")`; mutation M3 of recapture_snippets made the dry run write. The harness ran each mutated tool through the suite's real-artefact cases against the real root, then restored the TOOL by copy and never the artefacts. The literal `touched` lived in the scratchpad JSON, which is why the forensic grep of .py files and transcripts missed it.
INCIDENT_20260910_2226_ATTRIBUTED.timing: the matrices ran ~50 s after the two test files were written, matching the finding's 22:26:40 UTC window; both matrices reported M6/M3 as KILLED by the real-artefact case, which is only possible if the mutated tool reached the real files
INCIDENT_20260910_2226_ATTRIBUTED.how_it_was_caught: self — the matrix output showed M3 killed by the real-manifest case, I ran git status and saw 55 modified tracked files; the session was rate-limited before I could report. The coordinator restored from HEAD first.
INCIDENT_20260910_2226_ATTRIBUTED.what_prevented_loss: git. The committed readings were intact; only unstaged working-tree bytes were destroyed.
INCIDENT_20260910_2226_ATTRIBUTED.correction_shipped: commit 1325494 — real_artifact_case means READ; the meta-test tracer refuses (PermissionError before the bytes land) any write/unlink/rename/replace/rmdir/truncate under a guarded tree, records op+mode+path, marks the row refused, fails the verdict and --enforce; `--guarded <command>` runs anything under the same refusal and the mutation harness now runs every suite through it. Both matrices re-run under the guard: M6 and M3 GUARDED, zero bytes landed, guarded trees clean.
